profile.name: Thuan | KayStar
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer | MSc Student | System Architecture Enthusiast

summary: I am a full-stack developer with over 3 years of professional experience delivering ERP platforms, e-commerce solutions, social network systems, and DPM software. I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Applied Information Technology at the University of Industry and Trade in Ho Chi Minh City (HUIT). My work is driven by clean system design, solid domain modeling, and a practical approach to building software that lasts. I actively explore AI-assisted development to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed, and solution quality.

experiences.title: Developer
details: Migrate the legacy DPM (Digital Process Management) system from SharePoint to a new .NET + React platform.
Analyze process flows, approvals, forms and SharePoint data for migration into the new system.
Implement backend/frontend features with .NET and React based on migrated business logic.
Coordinate testing, business validation and bug fixing during migration.
Improve maintainability after moving away from the SharePoint platform.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer
details: Delivered enterprise business systems across backend services, frontend applications, data storage and release workflows.
Applied Clean Architecture, domain modeling, CQRS and microservices thinking to structure complex business products.
Worked with .NET, React, SQL Server and Azure DevOps across product development workflows.
Integrated Power BI, OpenAI and SQL Server stored procedures for internal business systems.
Built reusable components and refactored shared backend/frontend foundations for maintainability.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer
details: Delivered e-commerce, ERP and social network software across database, API and web admin layers.

Worked with maintainability-focused enterprise software domains where business clarity and extensibility mattered.
Guided new team members, reviewed code and collaborated through Agile/Scrum workflows.
